Request for Proposal / Deliverable Submission: Project Management Plan (PMP)
Document Reference: RFP-PMP-2026-V1
Project Title: Enterprise Digital Systems & Infrastructure Implementation
Issuing Authority: Project Management Office (PMO)
Distribution: Confidential // Enterprise Delivery Partners
1. Executive Summary & Objective
The Project Management Office (PMO) formally requests the submission of a comprehensive Project Management Plan (PMP) from the Lead Delivery Partner / Systems Integrator.
The purpose of this document is to establish the baseline execution strategy, governance model, controls, resource allocations, and operational frameworks required to manage project execution through delivery, validation, and transition to operations on time, within approved budget, and in adherence to defined quality benchmarks.
2. Scope of the Request
The selected delivery partner must submit a fully articulated Project Management Plan covering all primary knowledge areas and management subsidiaries aligned with standard PMI (PMBOK) and Prince2 frameworks. The PMP must address the entire system development and deployment lifecycle across the following phases:
Initiation & Baseline Discovery
Architecture, Engineering & Configuration
Integration, Quality Assurance & Security Hardening
User Acceptance Testing (UAT) & Pilot Rollout
Final Cutover, Operational Handover & Close-Out
3. Required PMP Subsidiary Plans & Core Deliverables
The submitted Project Management Plan must contain the following itemized sections and subsidiaries:
3.1 Scope Management & Baseline
Scope Baseline Definition: Clear Work Breakdown Structure (WBS) down to Work Package level (Level 4/5) accompanied by a detailed WBS Dictionary.
Scope Verification & Validation: Formal procedure for deliverable inspection, review gates, and formal stakeholder sign-off criteria.
Change Control Process: Integrated Change Control (ICC) workflow, evaluation timelines, impact analysis templates, and escalation protocols for change requests (CRs).
3.2 Schedule Baseline & Milestone Management
Critical Path Method (CPM) Schedule: Integrated master schedule (IMS) in Gantt format detailing activity dependencies (FS, SS, FF, SF), leads, lags, and float analysis.
Milestone Table: Summary of major contractual, design, testing, and operational handover gates.
Schedule Monitoring: Schedule Variance (SV) and Schedule Performance Index (SPI) monitoring cadences, cadence of baseline resets, and variance recovery mechanisms.
3.3 Cost Baseline & Financial Management
Cost Estimation & Allocation: Work package-level cost breakdown, capital expenditures (CapEx), operational expenditures (OpEx), and license fee schedules.
Earned Value Management (EVM): Formulae and reporting cadences for Planned Value (PV), Earned Value (EV), Actual Cost (AC), Cost Variance (CV), and Cost Performance Index (CPI).
Contingency & Reserves: Definition and governance of Management Reserves vs. Project Contingency Reserves.
3.4 Quality Management & Assurance (QA/QC)
Quality Standards & Metrics: Defect severity classifications (Critical, Major, Minor, Cosmetic) and resolution turn-around times (TAT).
Quality Gates & Stage Reviews: Entrance and exit criteria for Architecture Review Boards (ARB), Test Readiness Reviews (TRR), and Operational Readiness Reviews (ORR).
Audit Schedules: Cadence of internal process quality audits and external compliance verifications.
3.5 Resource & Staffing Management
Organizational Breakdown Structure (OBS): Hierarchical governance structure, staffing ramp-up/ramp-down curves, and project organogram.
RACI Matrix: Detailed Responsible, Accountable, Consulted, and Informed matrix mapped across all major milestones and lifecycle deliverables.
Skill Matrix & Key Personnel: Minimum qualifications, certifications, security clearance levels, and backup replacement commitments for key named personnel.
3.6 Communications & Stakeholder Governance
Stakeholder Register: Matrix detailing stakeholder influence, interest levels, communication cadence, and reporting formats.
Governance Meeting Cadence:
Daily: Technical stand-ups and operational blockers.
Weekly: Project Manager / Lead Engineer progress status reviews.
Bi-Weekly / Monthly: Steering Committee executive oversight sessions.
Information Radiators & Dashboards: Automated tooling, executive summaries, and real-time sprint/milestone burndown reporting.
3.7 Risk, Issue & Opportunity Management
Risk Management Framework: Qualitative assessment criteria (Probability vs. Impact matrix) and Quantitative Risk Analysis (EMV/Monte Carlo methodology).
Risk Register: Initial log capturing technical, architectural, vendor, dependency, and regulatory risks, complete with assigned owners and mitigation/fallback plans.
Issue & Escalation Protocols: Severity-based escalation ladder with defined service-level objectives (SLOs) for blocker resolution.
3.8 Procurement & Subcontractor Oversight
Vendor & Third-Party Dependencies: Inventory of all subcontractor services, third-party software licenses, and external APIs.
Procurement Schedule: Lead-time tracking for hardware, compute provisioning, and license activations.
Subcontractor Quality Audits: Evaluation criteria and performance tracking protocols for subcontracted labor.
4. Required Milestone Schedule
5. Submission Requirements & Format Guidelines
Submissions must comply with the following structural parameters:
Document Format: Deliverable must be provided in editable document format (.docx) and archived PDF (.pdf), accompanied by the native schedule file (.mpp or .xml).
Language: English (all technical specifications, architecture diagrams, and commercial models).
Traceability: Cross-reference table indicating exact sections where each RFP requirement and subsidiary plan is satisfied.
Sign-Off Sheet: Dedicated signature page for the Lead Project Manager, Delivery Director, Enterprise Architect, and Client Steering Committee Lead.
Milestone Code | Deliverable / Gate Description | Target Due Date
M-01 | Draft Project Management Plan (PMP) Initial Review | T + 10 Business Days
M-02 | Final Approved PMP Baseline & Steering Committee Sign-off | T + 20 Business Days
M-03 | Completion of Technical Discovery & WBS Dictionary Sign-off | Phase 1 Completion
M-04 | Mid-Term Progress Review & Earned Value Assessment (EVM Gate 1) | Phase 2 Midpoint
M-05 | Integrated UAT & Security Quality Sign-off (TRR) | Pre-Cutover
M-06 | Final Operational Transition, Handover Runbooks & Close-out Review | Project Conclusion
